sets.question: A report only needs the number of visits per clinic. What should you export?
options: All patient-level rows, just in case
Only the counts per clinic
The full patient records
Whatever your access allows

sets.question: Under HIPAA, what is the latest moment affected individuals must be notified of a breach?
options: 72 hours after it is discovered
No later than 60 days after it is discovered
At the end of the year
Only if the press finds out

sets.question: You suspect PHI was sent to the wrong person. What do you do?
options: Investigate on your own first
Report it to Compliance the same day
Wait to see if anyone complains
Delete the email and forget it

sets.section: Where PHI may and may not go
sets.question: Where may PHI be pasted?
options: Slack, if the channel is private
Jira, in a restricted project
Only in Compliance-approved systems covered by a BAA
Any AI tool, if it is popular

sets.question: What does the access log record?
options: Nothing, access is anonymous
Who accessed which record and when
Only failed logins
Only access from outside the office

sets.question: Which of these is PHI?
options: A patient's name together with a diagnosis
The address of a clinic
The total number of clinics
A public holiday calendar

sets.question: You have technical access to a whole patient record but need one field. What may you open?
options: The whole record, since you have access
Only the field you need
The records of other patients too
Nothing ever

sets.question: A colleague asks to use your login for a minute. What do you do?
options: Share it, it is only a minute
Refuse: use your own account only and never share credentials
Share it but change the password later
Ask IT to share it for you

sets.question: When can you receive access to a system with patient information?
options: On your first day
After passing this stage and Compliance approving it
When your manager says so
After the onboarding closure only if you ask

sets.question: The official material does not answer your compliance question. Who do you ask?
options: You guess the answer
Claire Whitfield's Compliance team
Any colleague on Slack
Nobody
